mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% triggers stronger labor market confidence, boosting corporate earnings and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite UNRATE falling below 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward trends in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and monthly industrial production (INDPRO) signal robust demand-side growth, driving corporate profits and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO above their 12-month moving averages
failure_condition: Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month rolling window when both GDPC1 and INDPRO are above their 12-month averages.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate above 4.5% for three consecutive months indicates a tightening monetary policy cycle, raising borrowing costs and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in the tightening cycle are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) compared to baseline.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden surge in demand for housing services (HOUST) above 1,700 units triggers increased corporate investment and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are not positive when HOUST crosses above 1700, with t-test p > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A convergence of rising labor demand (PAYEMS) and falling unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market, enhancing corporate productivity and equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS crosses above 142,631 and UNRATE falls below 5.0%
failure_condition: SPX returns are not positive when both PAYEMS crosses above 142,631 and UNRATE below 5.0%, with t-test p > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over quarterly periods indicates expanding supply-side capacity, reducing production costs and boosting corporate margins, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO's 60-day rolling average growth rate does not correlate with SPX 20d returns (Pearson r < 0.3 over 5-year window).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle labor market expansion, simultaneous declines in unemployment (UNRATE < 4.5%) and rising labor demand (PAYEMS > 140,000) signal peak employment, prompting corporate investment and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns in the late-cycle labor expansion regime are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE <4.5% and PAYEMS >140,000.
